APPROVE
The extracted helpers keep the original evaluation order and short-circuiting, so behaviour is unchanged, and removing the nested ternary chain, the `&&` sequence and the switch expression drops the method well below 15. One caveat: the source wasn't available here, so I couldn't build it to confirm that `name`, `lines` and `words` really are `Match`, `string[]` and `List<string>`, as the new helper signatures assume.
